recommendation: Keep this fix. If the work group later wants XML Digital Signatures in FHIR to use application/pkcs7-signature instead, handle that through a new final Jira decision because it would require coordinated changes to the Signature.sigFormat definition, examples, and signature page.
issue_request: FHIR-47211 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6. It asked for Signature.data and signature rules to clarify that XML Digital Signature and JSON/JWS signatures are not mandatory tied to the representation format of the resource being signed, to replace contentType references with Signature.sigFormat, and to say that FHIR resources may be signed over either Canonical XML or Canonical JSON as indicated by Signature.targetFormat. Its second part deferred canonical rules for embedded signatures to FHIR-45023.
initial_application: The March 2025 Security WG update commit 8866264 and PR #3405, merged as d184c744, applied the requested wording in the then-current datatype/signature source, including sigFormat terminology, cross-format Signature.data text, and Canonical XML-or-JSON rule text.
additional_context: The current build uses source/signatures.html as the active Digital Signatures page through source/hierarchy.xml, and Signature is an active normative datatype in source/fhir.ini with source/datatypes/signature.xml as its spreadsheet source. Later signature rewrites moved the detailed rules into source/signatures.html and introduced application/pkcs7-signature for XML Digital Signature, but no final Jira or WG disposition was found that supersedes FHIR-47211 on this MIME value. The Signature.sigFormat definition and current XML-signature examples still use application/signature+xml. FHIR-45023 remains Triaged and unresolved.
reconciliation: Changed source/signatures.html so the XML Digital Signature rule says Signature.sigFormat is application/signature+xml. The active page already contains the requested method-independence and targetFormat Canonical XML/JSON wording, so no redundant prose was added elsewhere.
source_changes: source/signatures.html: changed the XML Digital Signature Signature.sigFormat MIME value from application/pkcs7-signature to application/signature+xml.
